parameters.name: GeographicRegionId
parameters.description:
The ID of the area to query. Valid values: 

- **china**: the Chinese mainland.

- **asia-pacific**: Asia-Pacific.

- **europe**: Europe.

- **north-america**: North America.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page in a paged query. Default value: **10**. Valid values: **1** to **50**.
